description: Change the skip check boundary from > 0 to >= 0, causing an infinite loop or wrong condition when numToSkip is 0.
Reset entryOffset to -1 instead of 0 after parsing a header, causing calculation errors on the next entry's offset.
Change the GNULongNameEntry trailing null terminator check from > 0 to > 1, failing to strip single-character null-terminated strings.
Accidentally assign entrySize to 0 instead of currEntry.getSize() at the end of the method.
Negate the isPaxHeader check so that Pax headers are skipped or incorrectly processed.
